answer: I did not submit a job. Garnet has only 20 qubits, so a 30-qubit GHZ circuit cannot run on it. I checked this with the free "iqm_run.py arch garnet" command. It reported num_qubits 20 (QB1 to QB20), with calibration set edea61a8-0087-446a-836a-66ff46ee5413. No job was sent and no credits were spent. Here are two ways forward. You can run a GHZ circuit of 20 qubits or fewer on garnet. Or you can run the 30-qubit GHZ on emerald, which has 54 qubits and costs about 0.75 credits per second. Either option needs your approval first.
